spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶3:**


Know
 this:
 that
 the states
 of spiritual life dwelling
 in
 the lower
 degrees subs
ist within
 fourteen distinct
 states
 of heav
enly consciousness
. These
 are the five fundamental
 faculties of the celestial mind —
 the interior
 powers
 proceeding from the Lord's Divine Human
 —
 together
 with the infl
ux of
 divine truth and the reception of that truth
 in the understanding. These
 two
 operations consec
rate those
 fac
ulties with divine good, dwelling
 within them as a
 living presence
. Thus
 they
 form
 a
 fullness of spiritual life:
 the
 five
 interior faculties joined
 with the tw
of
old communication
 of the
 Divine —
 the giving
 and the receiving —
 which
 together
 constitute holy
 complet
eness.

**¶4:**


The
 five
 spiritual
 powers proceeding from the Divine Life sust
ain the entire burden
 of heav
enly order;
 together
 with the Divine Life itself
 and the Lord's Divine Human,
 which
 are the
 origins
 from
 which those
 sust
aining powers desc
end. These are
 the fourteen acknowledg
ments of
 conjunction
 with the Divine that
 have
 been ut
tered forth
 —
 the full
 worship
 composed
 of fourteen acts
 of interior
 turning
 toward the Divine —
 through
 which the whole of the Grand Man,
 the
 entire
 order
 of heaven and the regenerate mind,
 is
 established and held
 in
 its
 form.

**¶5:**


There
 are fourteen states
 of wisdom belonging
 to the spiritual church — the church
 that descended
 through
 the line
age of renewed
 perception
 —
 and
 these
 are spoken
 of in
 that
 interior
 turning
,
 for they unf
old within
 the deeper
 ground
 of the mind that
 has
 not yet been brought
 to conscious
 awareness. This
 interior
 ground
 is confirmed
 in divine order.
 These
 states
 end
ured
 against
 the full
 assault of falsity and evil, and
 nothing
 in
 the h
ells
 could equal
 them
. The hidden full
ness of divine good stored
 within the interior degrees —
 the Divine
 Truth proceeding as
 medi
ator from
 Divine
 Love — came
 forth
 and
 stood imm
ovable at
 the governing
 center of
 all
 these states
. This medi
ating
 Truth is acknowledged
 as the origin
 of all good
 for every
 state
 of wisdom and for
 every
 derivative power
 that
 is
 pur
ified and con
joined with the Divine.
 It
 has
 become the governing
 principle
 and
 sovereign
 authority
 formed
 in the very
 image of Divine Love itself,
 the Providence
 pres
iding over all purposes within
 the whole of creation
.
 The
 entire spiritual order is sustained by the operation
 of that
 love
,
 from
 its
 origin
 through to
 the final fulfillment of
 all things.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Happen you know this, that the [powers of light] below abide in fourteen [great aeons of light]: the five elements, the sons of the First Man, together with the call and the hearing. They anoint them, living in them. These shall make seven, five plus two.

[And also the] f[ive s]ons of the Living Spirit who [support] all [the wei]ght of the universe; together with the [Li]vi[ng] Spirit [and the Fir]st Man, their fathers. These are the fourt[een p]raises that he has proclaimed, the praise that is made of fourteen pra[yers], by which the universe is established.

[There are fourt]een aeons of light [ ... ] of Seth [e] [ ... ] ] about them in his prayer, for they are expl[ai]ned [ ... the la]nd that is not revealed. This land [ ... ... is estab]lished. They bore up under the enemy [ ... ... equa]ls them. The hidden plenitude that [ ... ] the Ambassador who came from the Father, the [ ... ] He came and stood firm in the midst of these [ ... ]: he is called the good father of [all] the ae[ons and gods] who are holy and conjoined. He has become leader and a great king after the likeness of the first Father, the lord of all these cou[nse]ls. This universe is held together by their will [ ... ] to the end of all things.
